description.value: Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.
Must be paired. +2 Perception and Lip Reading and Conceal/Reveal Object when using sight.

information.notes:
Quiet Mae

Lieutenant · Fixer · Little China

Owns a tea room under the Silver Dragon. Speaks in a whisper and never repeats herself. Works with the Tyger Claws, but doesn't belong to them.

Tactics: Keeps her distance, strikes first from ambush, leaves through the kitchen.

HP 40 · Seriously Wounded 20 · Death Save 5

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
